evidenceLevel: Independent re-reading of the stored article abstracts and exact titles. Several stored abstracts are compact/truncated; this is not a claim of full publisher-text review or a complete 536-card audit.

items.reason: A methylene-bridged thianthrenium reagent connects alkene hydroalkylation to multiple nucleophile classes; modular bond construction and drug-fragment assembly are the principal preparative contribution, not a materials-performance readout.

Complementary stereodivergent annulation/cycloaddition-ring-expansion routes access angular triquinanes and explicitly culminate in arnicenone synthesis; completed target synthesis independently supports scope.

Rh-catalyzed acrylamide/allylic-difluoride coupling provides enantioenriched fluorinated 1,4-dienes, with a divergent piperidone route; reported yields and stereoselectivity are preparative-method outcomes.

Interrupted homolytic substitution combines amino migration and trimolecular radical coupling; the abstract explicitly reports more than 60 alkylamine products and modular pharmaceutical-scaffold construction.

Alternating amphiphilic polymer sequence is used to investigate membrane/interfacial function and antibiotic potentiation. The user's explicit boundary supersedes the old broad polymer-method include; see literature-scope-corrections.json.

Selective engineered-P450 C18 oxidation is used in an actual ten-step synthesis of spiromyrrhene B, unlike generic protein/domain compatibility engineering. Keep its synthetic contribution; whether the displayed label should say total synthesis or semisynthesis from sclareol needs a separate terminology check.

Enantioselective aza-Michael addition is evaluated across 61 linear/cyclic-enone examples, with beta-amino-carbonyl products and downstream synthetic applications; direct general substrate-to-product method.

The abstract describes a one-pot multicomponent fluorophore library but emphasizes photophysics, crystal packing and Candida imaging. This is not enough to assert either pure materials research or a sufficiently broad new preparative method.
items.evidenceNeeded: Obtain the reaction scheme, substrate combinations, number and diversity of isolated products, yields, and novelty of the multicomponent transformation rather than only appendage/property variation.
items.nextAction: Prioritize full article/SI scope evidence in the next small review batch; do not blanket-exclude all fluorescent-product synthesis.

items.reason: Calcium carbide and diselenides undergo K2S-mediated tandem selenylation/cyclization to benzoselenazole derivatives; the preparative heterocycle construction is explicit and is not inferred merely from biological relevance.

AI-generated thiolation domains and recombinant NRPS variants establish protein/domain and biosynthetic-assembly-line engineering. Product yield and protein stability do not by themselves establish general organic preparative scope; see literature-scope-corrections.json.

Resonant acoustic mixing accelerates practical PhF halide formation, amino-ester protection and saponification; the abstract names unprotected alcohol-bearing amino-ester substrates rather than only reporting kinetics.
A tandem nitrile hydration/alkyne hydroarylation gives 2-alkenyl primary benzamides from cyanoarylboronic acids and alkynes; direct chemoselective and stereoselective product construction.
Pd/norbornene chemistry introduces multiple cyclic amines at carbazole C1 while tolerating acyl and halogen substitution; it extends Catellani preparative scope to unprotected carbazoles.
Cu LMCT/HAT/SET enables divergent stereoselective enamide synthesis and named drug late-stage functionalizations; mechanistic investigation accompanies, rather than replaces, the preparative method.

Iron-catalyzed coupling of trifluoromethyl alkenes with cyclic-acetal-substituted alkyl iodides affords structurally varied fluorinated scaffolds; medicinal motivation is not the sole inclusion evidence.
Ligand-free Eu(OTf)3 photoactivation enables several BCB cycloaddition/annulation classes, gram-scale preparation and a sonidegib bioisostere; broadly preparative scaffold synthesis.
Pd-carbene-mediated BCB-carboxamide remodeling gives functionalized azabicyclohexanones across electronically/structurally diverse substrates and gram-scale synthesis.

The abstract centers on protonation-dependent ring-opening barriers, kinetic windows and intermediate trapping. Stable precursors and on-demand activation may have synthetic utility, but broad isolated cycloadduct/substrate scope is not stated.
items.evidenceNeeded: Obtain preparative trapping tables, isolated yields and substrate diversity to distinguish a general synthetic precursor method from a primarily mechanistic acid-base/strain-reactivity study.
items.nextAction: Prioritize article/SI before reaffirming inclusion; no evidence-backed final exclusion is claimed here.

items.reason: Diaryliodonium arylation of tertiary malonates builds benzylic quaternary centers with broad aryl electrophile scope and telescoped reagent generation/C-C coupling.
Copper ATRA couples primary, secondary and tertiary haloalkanes with vinylphosphonates and demonstrates product derivatization; explicit broad radical-precursor scope.
Asymmetric Michael addition joins fluoroheteroaryl acetates and fluoroalkyl enones to defined adjacent F/CFx stereocenters, with scale-up and derivatizations.
Visible-light difluoromethyl-radical addition/chlorine trapping applies to differently substituted alkenes, natural-product functionalization and C-Cl diversification.

Aryl trichloromethane, alkene and tert-butyl nitrite furnish isoxazoline/isoxazole scaffolds through in-situ nitrile-oxide formation and cycloaddition; general heterocycle preparation is the stated objective.
Selenoglycosides and diphenyliodonium salts enable room-temperature O-glycosylation; EDA/halogen-bond mechanistic evidence supports an explicit preparative glycosylation method.
